programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Illinois, a 16-year-old boy goes to speak with a contractor about a summer job. He tells his mother it'll only take a minute, but no one ever sees him again. Working with psychics Carol Broman and Dorothy Allison, police identify the kidnapper and discover he's killed many others. When two women are abducted and found stabbed to death outside Morristown, NJ, police believe they have a serial killer on their hands. Local psychic Nancy Orlen Weber works with detectives to try and catch him before he finds his next victim.
